queries:
WITH event_ratio AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(spent * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget
    WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
    FROM event_ratio
    WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT e.link_to_event,
       e.avg_ratio / o.overall_avg AS relative
FROM event_ratio e, overall o
ORDER BY relative DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_spent_ratio
FROM budget
WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY link_to_event;
SELECT e.event_id, AVG(b.spent / b.amount) AS ratio
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_id;
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event);
SELECT AVG(total_amount)
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_amount
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT link_to_event FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event);
